$comment: The source of sf-file-download's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/download-file (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

full-width.summary: The row fills its container, the look it had before 1.5.0; without it the row is as wide as its text, up to the container (decision C51), as sf-button's full-width.

file-name.summary: The file's visible name and the name it is saved under. Empty: the link's last part, else «Файл» in the page's language.

file-size.summary: The size as text, in the page's units («2,4 МБ»). A screen reader hears it with the unit in words («2,4 мегабайта»). Empty with an href to this page's own server: asked with one HEAD request and written in the page's language; any other address (another origin, data:, blob:) is not asked -- give the size.

file-type.summary: The file's type in words (PDF, XLSX), shown before the size: «PDF · 2,4 МБ» (decision C25). Never in file-size.

icon.summary: Former way to name the file's type by a glyph, which took the download sign's place (decision C25): give the type in file-type. Still drawn and noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01.

href.summary: Real resource destination; renders a native anchor when enabled.

download.summary: Kept for compatibility: a file link downloads in the same tab whether or not it is given (decision C25); only target="_blank" opens a tab instead.

disabled.summary: Render a disabled button with no live destination.

state.summary: ready: the file can be fetched. preparing: the application is making it -- the spinner in the sign's place (the progress ring with value), «Готовим файл…» or «Готовим… 45 %», aria-busy, a press is ignored, «Отменить» beside it while cancelable; the start is said. When the host sets ready again with an href, the file a person pressed for is fetched by itself if it came within 10 s and the page is in sight, else the row says «Готово» and offers «Скачать» (decision C51); the end is said. error: it could not be made -- one grid of the error sign, the text and «Повторить» (decision C88): the sign on the name's first line, the name in two lines at most (the whole name in its tooltip and for a screen reader), «Не удалось собрать» and error-text a step smaller under it inside the frame, «Повторить» at the end of the first line -- under the text in a column narrower than 360 px, and the icon alone (its name in aria-label and a tooltip) only when its words do not fit there either; the error is said at once.

error-text.summary: Why the file could not be made and what happens next, the last line of the failed row's text, inside its frame, a step smaller than the name (decision C88; «Сервер не ответил. Файл соберётся заново.»).

target.summary: Where the link opens. Empty (default): the file downloads in the same tab. _blank: the file is opened to view in a new tab; the link shows the open-in-new sign and says «(откроется в новой вкладке)» to a screen reader (decision C25).

value.summary: While preparing: the share made, per cent (0 to 100, clamped), drawn as the progress ring in the sign's place and «Готовим… 45 %» (decision C51). Absent: the spinner and «Готовим файл…».

cancelable.summary: While preparing, «Отменить» stands beside the row; its press sends the cancelable cancel, and unless a listener prevents it the row is ready again (decision C51), as sf-progress-run's cancelable.

request.summary: A person pressed the file: the request to fetch it (sf-file-download-request), cancelable. A page that cancels it takes the download over; to prepare the file it sets state="preparing" (value as it goes), then ready with the href, or error. Its former name sf-file-download-download doubled the word (decision C51) and is a dated alias until 2027-01-01.

retry.summary: A person pressed «Повторить» in a row that could not be made (vocabulary §5 retry): the host prepares it again and sets the state; the file is fetched when it is ready, as after the first press.

cancel.summary: A person pressed «Отменить» beside a file being made (vocabulary §5 cancel, cancelable): the host stops the work. Unless a listener prevents it the row is ready again at once; a host that prevents it sets ready itself. Either way the cancel is said.

relations.name: cl-button
$comment: «Повторить» in a row that could not be made, «Отменить» beside one being made, «Скачать» beside one ready (decision C51).

relations.name: cl-button-icon
$comment: «Повторить» as the icon alone in a failed row whose column has no room for its words even under the text (decision C88).

relations.name: tooltip
$comment: The whole name of a failed row, cut after two lines, and the name of «Повторить» drawn as the icon alone (decision C88): the Framework's plain tooltip, shown on hover and keyboard focus.

relations.name: spinner
$comment: The spinner in the sign's place while the file is prepared: its box is the class sheet's, the motion the spinner sheet's.

relations.name: progress-ring
$comment: The progress ring in the sign's place while the file is prepared with value (decision C51): its box is the class sheet's, the ring the progress-ring sheet's.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: A native <a> while href is set and the file is not disabled, a native <button> otherwise; the file name is the visible text, and after it hidden words a screen reader hears with pauses: «Смета.csv, CSV, 112 байт», the unit in words (decision C51); the visible «CSV · 112 Б» is aria-hidden. Preparing: aria-busy="true", «Готовим файл…» or «Готовим… 45 %» in its name, «Отменить» a button of its own. A row that could not be made is a group named by the file with «Повторить» («Повторить: <name>») in it; a ready row after a long wait is text with «Скачать» («Скачать <name>») beside it. Two hidden live regions: the start, the end and a cancel are said politely (role=status), an error at once (role=alert). A link that opens a tab adds «(откроется в новой вкладке)» to its name.

--sf-file-download-background-color.x-summary: The fill at rest; hover, press and the disabled state have their own. Formerly --sf-download-file-background-color, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-border-color.x-summary: The border at rest. Formerly --sf-download-file-border-color, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-radius.x-summary: The corner. Formerly --sf-download-file-radius, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-padding.x-summary: The inner padding. Formerly --sf-download-file-padding, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-gap.x-summary: Space between the sign, the name and the type and size. Formerly --sf-download-file-gap, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-icon-size.x-summary: The sign's size (and the spinner's while the file is prepared). Formerly --sf-download-file-icon-size, still read until 2027-01-01.

--sf-file-download-icon-color.x-summary: The sign's ink (and the spinner's). Formerly --sf-download-file-icon-color, still read until 2027-01-01.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-file-download for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.summary: Emitted once for an enabled native destination or application-owned action, from the rendered .sf-download-file root; bubbles to the host, is not composed and not cancelable.

x-summary: Native file download or application-owned file preparation action.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: alias-conflict: the request is download (sf-download-file-download), as vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1 writes it; the old sf-download-file:click is its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01; bx-simai.main listens to it, vocabulary §9.2). The alias table's earlier sf-download-file-click was never shipped, so it gets no row.

events (§8): download is cancelable -- a page or a rule that refuses it (preventDefault) stops the browser's download -- and carries {href, fileName, download}; it is sent on the host, not the inner link, so the shim sends the old name after it. The class binder (component/download-file) takes it as onActivate and no longer sends its own event for the Smart element.
side-effects: network. With href and no file-size the class binder asks the file's size with one HEAD request (same origin credentials) and writes it; §4.7 says so now.
version 1.1.0: the event is renamed behind a dated alias and made cancelable (§4.10).

a11y-role: link, the native <a> the template draws while href is set and the file is not disabled; without href, or disabled, a native button (disabled: aria-disabled, not focusable). The name is the host's aria-label, else the file name (§4.8). Enter follows the link or presses the button.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.
size takes the ladder the class binder draws (1/3 to 3); a value off it reads as 1.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (Отчёт за август.pdf, 2,4 МБ, a download) plus a link that opens, a size, an icon and disabled.

css-variables: seven public variables (fill and border at rest, radius, padding, gap, icon size and colour), read by the class sheet with the internal token as fallback (§6) and listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: the tag is sf-file-download (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.file-download and the bundle cl-file-download follow it. sf-download-file stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-file-download, sf-download-file) (change journal tag-sf-download-file-to-sf-file-download, path-smart-download-file-to-file-download).

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-08): one height per size, the button's (docs review rule C01; component.download-file 1.1.0): sizes 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2 and 3 stand 24, 32, 40, 48 and 56 px on a wide screen beside an sf-button of the same size -- they stood 26, 38, 42, 54 and 70 -- with the button's icon, side padding and label inset from the size ladder and the border inside the height. The file name is one line ending in an ellipsis when it does not fit (it broke inside words at size 3) and carries the whole name as its title. The keys a person presses are listed: Tab reaches it, Enter follows the link or presses the button, Space presses the button (msg-c84f2727, the family's keys). The documentation names the request sf-file-download-download, the event the probe page listens to. Settings, values and events are unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (decision C25; docs review pre-check 2026-11-09 DF-02, DF-03, DF-04, DF-08, DF-09). state ready|preparing|error: preparing puts the Framework's spinner in the sign's box, «Готовим файл…» in place of the type and the size and aria-busy on the link or button, and a press does nothing; the host that cancelled the request and prepared the file sets ready with the href, and the file is fetched once for the person who pressed. error keeps the file and puts an sf-alert «Не удалось подготовить файл» (error-text its words) with «Повторить» under it; the press sends sf-file-download-retry {href, fileName}. file-type gives the type in words before the size («PDF · 2,4 МБ»); icon, which put a type glyph in the download sign's place, is still drawn but noted once until 2027-01-01 (change journal setting-file-download-icon-to-file-type). A file link downloads in the same tab: target is empty by default (it was _blank) and the download semantics are on unless target="_blank", which is a file opened to view and shows the open_in_new sign after the name with «(откроется в новой вкладке)» for a screen reader. An absent file-name is the link's last part, else «Файл» (it was File.pdf). The size the component asks for (HEAD) is written in the page's language by the core formatter, «2,4 МБ» (it was «2.4MB»): component.download-file 1.2.0. The public variables carry an x-summary for the reference. The request's name is unchanged (sf-file-download-download; a shorter name is a proposal to the owner). The element answers what its template draws: fileName is the given name, else the link's last part, else «Файл», and download is true for a file link unless target="_blank" (template-context).

version 1.3.1: the first-paint snapshot of the error example is retaken: the sf-alert it draws takes the notice's actions (smart.alert 1.2.0, decision C35): a tonal primary low retry button; nothing of its own changes.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-10): a minor (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 DF-11, DF-13, DF-15). The public variables carry the element's name: --sf-file-download-background-color, -border-color, -radius, -padding, -gap, -icon-size, -icon-color; each reads its former name --sf-download-file-* under it until 2027-01-01 (change journal token-file-download-variable-names). The error state draws the file and its notice in one column of its own, .sf-download-file__stack (gap --sf-space-1/3, the prototype's): the host is display: contents, so as two siblings a flex row of the page put the notice beside the file. A data: or blob: href is not asked for its size (no HEAD request; the browser refused it with net::ERR_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED): the page that made the bytes passes file-size; nor is an address that leads back to the page itself (#, #part, the page's own URL), which asked the page for its own length (docs acceptance 2026-11-10, L2). After «Повторить» the focus the notice's button held moves to the file when the notice goes away; it fell to the page's body (L1). While preparing, «Готовим файл…» stays beside the name while the name has 9rem (--sf-e8) and moves under it, one whole text line, when it has not; it took the name's whole room (0-6 px at 160-200 px) and stood past the box (L3). component.download-file 1.3.0. The request keeps its name sf-file-download-download: vocabulary 1.1.5 §7 derives it from the tag and the §5 verb download, and another verb would be a synonym of download (§5.1).

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The file is a button until it has an href and a link after; a host that prepares the file sets the href when it is ready, the button was replaced by the link and the focus fell to the page's body (also on 1.4.0). The link now takes the focus the button held -- only when the focus was on the file, never taken from where the person moved.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-11): a minor (owner decision C51, study control/research/2026-11-10-download-file.md, prototype prototypes/download-file.html; component.download-file 1.4.0 carries the class side). The row is as wide as its text, up to its container; full-width stretches it (the look before). The type and the size stand right after the name, under it on a phone (below the sm step, 32rem, a step smaller), and the name is never cut: it wraps, the ellipsis and the title are gone (C34). A screen reader hears «name, type, size» with pauses and the unit in words («Смета.csv, CSV, 112 байт», «2,4 мегабайта»): hidden words after the name, the visible «CSV · 112 Б» aria-hidden. Preparing: value (0-100) draws the progress ring in the sign's box (20 in the 24 of size 1) and «Готовим… 45 %»; cancelable puts «Отменить» (sf-button, ghost, height low) beside the row, which sends the cancelable cancel and, unless it is prevented, returns the row to ready. The start, the end and a cancel are said in a polite live region, an error in an assertive one. A file the person pressed for is fetched by itself only if it came within 10 s and the page is in sight (visibilityState); otherwise the row shows the success sign, «Готово · CSV · 2,4 МБ» and «Скачать» (sf-button, filled, height low, «Скачать <name>») beside it, and the download is a fresh press. Error: the row itself shows it -- the error sign and border, «Не удалось собрать» in place of the type and the size, «Повторить» (sf-button, ghost, height low, icon refresh, «Повторить: <name>») at its end, error-text small under the row; the sf-alert notice under the file is gone (relation cl-alert goes, cl-button and progress-ring come), and with it DF-13. The word error-heading is failed-text; a page's own error-heading word is still said until 2027-01-01. When what held the focus is drawn away, the focus goes to «Повторить» or «Скачать», else to the row. The request is renamed sf-file-download-request: sf-file-download-download doubled the word (C51, DF-11); the old name is a dated same-detail alias until 2027-01-01 (change journal event-file-download-download-to-request), and the older names follow it. The size is asked (HEAD) only of an http(s) address on this page's own origin; another origin failed without CORS (DF-15). The public variables already carry the element's name since 1.4.0 (journal token-file-download-variable-names).

version 1.5.0, continued (2026-11-12; still unreleased): the failed row per owner decision C88 (prototype prototypes/file-download-row-composition.html, variant B), closing the C51 r2 question of «Повторить» as one icon. One grid of the sign, the text and «Повторить»; the same padding on every side (--sf-space-1/2 up to size 1, --sf-space-1 at 2 and 3); the sign centred on the name's first line; the name in two lines at most, then an ellipsis -- the whole name in the Framework tooltip and, whole in the markup, for a screen reader; «Не удалось собрать» and error-text one step smaller under the name, inside the frame, in the text's column (error-text moved into the row from under it). «Повторить» ends the first line; in a column narrower than 360 px (22.5rem, measured by the element) it goes under the text, its words on the text's edge; only when the button with its words does not fit there either is it sf-button-icon (refresh, aria-label «Повторить: <name>», the tooltip «Повторить»). New relations cl-button-icon (lazy) and tooltip; new part __tip; new modifiers --narrow and --retry-icon. Settings, events and keys unchanged.

owner_semantics.application_action: no href renders a button; a press sends the cancelable request sf-file-download-request
owner_semantics.disabled: disabled button with no live destination
owner_semantics.preparing: state preparing: spinner (or the progress ring with value) in the sign's place, aria-busy, presses ignored, «Отменить» with cancelable; ready again with an href fetches the file by itself within 10 s on a page in sight, else offers «Скачать»
owner_semantics.error: state error: the row shows the error with «Повторить» at its end; its press sends retry

compatibility.size_lookup: an empty size preserves the existing Content-Length lookup

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-download for one downloadable resource or an application-owned file preparation action.
do_not: Do not use a button when a stable resource href already exists
Do not leave href on an unavailable file
Do not use the decorative icon as the accessible name
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not put the file type in file-size or in icon: give it in file-type
Do not leave file-size empty for a file on another server, a data: or a blob: address: give the size
Do not fire several downloads at once for several files: offer one archive
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-file-download file-name="Отчёт за октябрь.pdf" file-type="PDF" file-size="2,4 МБ" href="/files/report.pdf"></sf-file-download>

sf-download-file:click.summary: Emitted once for an enabled native destination or application-owned action, from the rendered .sf-download-file root; bubbles to the host, is not composed and not cancelable.
